hook: Their tug was sinking in a hurricane. Four people were still aboard.
narration: This tug was sinking in Hurricane Harvey, and four people were still aboard.
It was taking on water beside a rig near Port Aransas, Texas.
A Coast Guard Dolphin crew from Corpus Christi landed and sent a swimmer out on a line.
Survival suits float and hold in body heat, [short pause] so a swimmer can tow people like rafts.
outcome: All four made it off that sinking tug and were airlifted to safety.
title: Tug sinking in Harvey, 4 still aboard
description:
During Hurricane Harvey, a Coast Guard rescue swimmer pulled four people from the sinking tug Signet Enterprise near Port Aransas, Texas, and they were airlifted to safety on Aug. 26, 2017.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video (Coast Guard Heartland), via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Coast_Guard_rescues_four_people_aboard_a_sinking_vessel_in_response_to_Hurricane_Harvey_(2017).webm
